title: oncall-shift-simulator-and-ephemeral-brief-bridge
author: Maya Kim
description: Adds two complementary operational tools: a lightweight on-call shift simulator that models responder availability, escalation probability, and alert handoff latency; and an ephemeral brief-bridge service that creates one-time WebRTC brief channels for responders to share audio/text context during high-severity incidents. Motivation: teams frequently ask for a way to estimate how changes to rotation policies (shift length, overlap windows, responder weights) affect mean time to acknowledge/escalate, and they need a low-friction way to share live context without SMS/Slack fatigue. This PR bundles a simulator CLI, a small in-process simulator library for scheduling heuristics, and a minimal brief-bridge shim that integrates with the incident-bot UI and the ephemeral attachments flow. Checklist: - [x] Simulator CLI and library with unit tests - [x] Brief-bridge service and UI path (opt-in behind flag) - [x] End-to-end smoke test for brief channel creation - [x] Documentation and runbook notes for SRE - [x] Feature gated via `ENABLE_BRIEF_BRIDGE` and `SIMULATOR_MODE` env vars Security note: brief-bridge tokens are single-use, short TTL (60s), and do not persist audio to disk by default. See docs/oncall-briefbridge.md and docs/oncall-sim.md for operational controls and recommended RBAC. Limitations: simulator currently models responder availability as a three-state Markov chain (on, muted, away) with configurable transition rates; it does not yet ingest historical paging data (follow-up linear item queued).

Maya Kim (2025-01-16): Will add CSV export and admin revocation endpoint. CSV added in next commit; revocation implemented via /api/admin/briefbridge/revoke (authz gated).

Priya Desai (2025-01-17): Security review: token TTL looks short but audio handling needs explicit consent logging. Add audit events for create/revoke; ensure brief-bridge does not bypass retention policies.
Maya Kim (2025-01-17): Added audit events and flagged in docs. Brief-bridge keeps audio in memory only; if customers enable persistence it's stored in encrypted S3 and subject to retention controls.
Anders Holm (2025-01-18): Found a race in simulate.Start when multiple overlapping shift changes occur. Requested a retry/backoff on internal scheduler updates.
Maya Kim (2025-01-19): Fixed scheduler race by introducing a compare-and-swap loop and added a deterministic unit test to cover concurrent rotation updates. CI re-run green.

release_notes: Add on-call shift simulator CLI/library for rotation experiments; add opt-in ephemeral brief-bridge for live responder context sharing (single-use tokens, admin revocation). See docs for gating and RBAC.
notes_for_ops: Enable FEATURE_ENABLE_BRIEF_BRIDGE=false by default in hosted; on-prem customers can opt-in. Simulator runs in dry-run mode unless SIMULATOR_MODE=api is set; heavy simulations should be run on dedicated worker nodes. Monitor brief-bridge token issuance metric briefbridge.tokens.issued and briefbridge.tokens.revoked.
